ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions cover the primary surface of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation originates from the central peduncle attachment, extending upward to the median notch and along the upper trailing edges. A distinct isolated black elliptical spot is located on the right lobe white field. Vertical black streaks are present on the inner-upper quadrant of the left lobe white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge; most prominent jagged peaks are located at the distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge boundary sweeping upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular, brownish-white multi-tonal pixel clusters indicating barnacle colonization at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, near-vertical low-intensity linear pixel disruptions on the upper-left white field near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation localized on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated dark oval marking positioned in the upper-mid section of the right lobe's white field.
